data.claim: Resumability is determined by whether the persisted state (event log, budget, and any non-deterministic state captures) forms a complete checkpoint at an event boundary. A halted run is resumable iff the checkpoint is complete: the event log is intact and self-verifying up to its last entry, the budget state equals the sum of all event costs subtracted from the initial budget, and every source of non-determinism that influenced the committed events is either (a) fully recorded in the events themselves, or (b) captured in a separate, replayable state vector. Resumption must be refused if any of these conditions are not met.
